LanguageData.VRESaurids_OutlanderRoughSaurid.descript: These cold-blooded lizard-like people have lived here for centuries, and instead of embracing technological progress, they chose industrial reliability. They are not afraid to utilise their military might to bring peace and order in the surrounding lands.\n\nOriginally engineered to survive on not-fully-terraformed planets with no humidity what-so-ever, saurids are a closely knit community that prefers to treat outsiders with aggression and show of force.
